name: NeRF in the Wild (NeRF-W)
definition: Addresses per-image appearance variations due to lighting and transient objects in real-life photographs by conditioning the color MLP on per-image appearance embeddings and using a separate MLP for transient objects.
summary: NeRF-W enables novel view synthesis for uncontrolled scenes by decoupling static geometry from dynamic appearance and transient objects, handling lighting variations and approximate camera poses.
